The '''Thaere sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], [[Dinlo]], [[Niian]] and [[Thaere Privo]].
